No previous findings were raised, so none remain unresolved. All factual claims about ICC Safety capabilities are hedged as published descriptions. The Ontario JHSC guide is cited with an appropriate caution about site-specific obligations. Workflow elements (role, input, decision, record, exception) are present across all four subsections. The illustrative example is labeled and uses an unnamed Canadian manufacturer. No FAQ section appears, consistent with the plan assigning none. Links use only the two supplied source URLs plus allowed internal site paths. No scope boundary violations, readability problems, or repetition were detected.
